notes: «وقال هشام يعني ابن حسان كبر ثم كبر وسجد» is a wording remark on the same chain (the same name هشام, a gloss on it), so it is left out; the gloss is not used.
The two «قال أبو داود» and «وروى حماد بن سلمة» remarks name other transmitters for the same saying: variant groups, never routes.

The second «محمد» and «أبي هريرة» in the variant group are not from the main chain; the variant reads its own names. The surface «محمد» is the same words as the chain's, so it stands for the same written name.
